title: The Wrong Hotel Booking
instructions: 这是一份原创模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请先听录音（或阅读文本），然后完成8道听力/阅读题。题目均为英文，解释为中文。注意：听力中有自然的对话和纠正，答案不会直接读出。语法部分先学习一般过去时的规则，再完成8道新句子练习题。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, I'm Mia. I have a booking for tonight. My reservation number is 4472.
Receptionist: Let me check. Ah, I see a problem. Your booking is for the City Hotel, not here. This is the River Hotel.
Mia: What? I booked the River Hotel. I'm sure. I checked the website last week.
Receptionist: The website says City Hotel. Maybe you clicked the wrong link when you booked online.
Mia: Oh no. I paid 120 dollars for two nights. Can I stay here?
Receptionist: We have one room free tonight. It's 80 dollars a night. But tomorrow we are full, so you cannot stay a second night.
Mia: OK. I'll take it for tonight. Then tomorrow I'll go to the City Hotel.
Receptionist: Good plan. After that, you can call the City Hotel to confirm your booking with them.
Mia: Yes. Finally, I'll check my email for the booking confirmation. That will show which hotel I really booked.
Receptionist: Here is your key. Room 305. The lift is on the left.
Mia: Thank you. I'm tired. I travelled for six hours by train.
Receptionist: You're welcome. Breakfast is from 7 to 10 in the morning.
Mia: Great. I'll see you tomorrow.

grammar.title: 一般过去时：规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时用来描述过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词的过去式通常在词尾加 -ed，例如：check → checked, book → booked。以 e 结尾的动词直接加 -d，例如：like → liked。辅音字母 + y 结尾的动词，变 y 为 i 再加 -ed，例如：study → studied。重读闭音节且末尾只有一个辅音字母的动词，双写该辅音字母再加 -ed，例如：stop → stopped。travel 在英式英语中常双写 l 变为 travelled，在美式英语中常写作 traveled。常用不规则动词的过去式需要单独记忆，例如：go → went, have → had, pay → paid, see → saw, take → took, is → was, are → were。表示顺序时，可以用 then（然后）、after that（在那之后）、finally（最后）来连接句子，使叙述更连贯。注意：本课新学的是 then / after that / finally 的用法，以及规则动词过去式的拼写规则；不规则动词过去式是复习内容。
grammar.example: I checked the website last week. Then tomorrow I'll go to the City Hotel. After that, you can call the City Hotel to confirm. Finally, I'll check my email for the booking confirmation.

questions.prompt: Yesterday I ______ my email for the booking confirmation.
questions.explanation: Yesterday表示过去，动词用过去式。check是规则动词，加-ed变成checked。

questions.prompt: Last week she ______ to the City Hotel by bus.
questions.explanation: Last week表示过去，go的过去式是不规则形式went。
questions.evidence: go → went 是不规则过去式。

questions.prompt: They ______ 80 dollars for the room last night.
questions.explanation: Last night表示过去，pay的过去式是不规则形式paid。
questions.evidence: pay → paid 是不规则过去式。

questions.prompt: We ______ a problem with the booking yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday表示过去，have的过去式是不规则形式had。
questions.evidence: have → had 是不规则过去式。

questions.prompt: He ______ the website two days ago.
questions.explanation: Two days ago表示过去，visit是规则动词，加-ed变成visited。

questions.prompt: First, I booked the room. ______, I checked my email.
She called the hotel. ______, she went to the room.
questions.evidence: after that 表示“在那之后”。

questions.prompt: We checked the booking. ______, we paid for the room.
